smoke: Disjoint 20-trial-per-SNR train and test pipeline smoke passed for four SNR levels; excluded from full calibration.
frozen_gates: Recorded prewarmed observed channel-estimate and received-grid power for four -10/-9/-8/-7 dB synthetic SNRs, 2,000 trials per SNR per split. No seed reuse; 5 train-only x quantiles, each split by train-only y median into ten leaves, >=200 samples per leaf/split and >=100 rescue events per split. Held-out weighted absolute calibration error <=0.05; 2D model Brier better than train-prevalence constant. Report x-only Brier without gate. True SNR is evaluation label only.
limits: Synthetic independent block Rayleigh/pre-fading AWGN only. Even a calibrated mixed-SNR model is not a DU/TDL q_use or joint scheduling result.
